initial_state.tagline: A simulated everything-store. Nothing here ships and nothing here is charged.

b0monitor27.title: Lumen 27-inch 4K USB-C Monitor
bullets: 90W USB-C power delivery over one cable
b0monitor27.description: A 27-inch 4K panel that drives a laptop and charges it down the same cable. The stand pivots, so two of these sit side by side without a gap.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Two of these side by side is the whole point
reviews.body: One cable to the laptop, 90W back the other way, and the bezels are thin enough that two of them read as one desktop. Docked a star because the stand needs a hex key you do not get in the box.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Replaced two older panels with one
reviews.body: Colour out of the box was close enough that I never opened the calibrator. Menu joystick is better than any button row.

reviews.author: bob
reviews.title: Fine, but read the refresh rate again
reviews.body: It is 60Hz. If you came from a 144Hz gaming panel you will notice, and no firmware update is going to change it.

b0dock11.title: Lumen 11-port Thunderbolt Dock
b0dock11.description: Eleven ports and a metal shell that stays cool. Pairs with the Lumen 27-inch panel on a single upstream cable.

reviews.author: alice
reviews.title: Ethernet finally keeps up
reviews.body: 2.5Gb to the switch and the dock does not warm up. The SD reader is slower than the spec sheet suggests.

b0kbd87.title: Meridian 87-key Mechanical Keyboard
b0kbd87.description: Eighty-seven keys, a case you can actually open, and sockets so you can change your mind about the switches later.

reviews.author: bob
reviews.title: Third one I have bought
reviews.body: Hot-swap means it outlives whatever switch fashion is current. Back in stock and I buy another.

b0chair.title: Harborline Task Chair
b0chair.description: The chair that quietly appeared under half the desks on the fourth floor.

b0lamp.title: Marrow Point Desk Lamp
b0lamp.description: A lamp with one dial that does colour temperature and one that does brightness, which is one more dial than most lamps manage.

b0book-det.title: Deterministic Systems in Practice
bullets: Covers replay, snapshotting and ordered inputs
b0book-det.description: A working engineer's book about removing the clock, the random number generator and unordered iteration from a system you still have to ship.

reviews.author: carol
reviews.title: Chapter 7 is the one
reviews.body: The chapter on ordered inputs is worth the cover price on its own. We handed it round the team before the Atlas review.

b0bottle.title: Puget 32oz Insulated Bottle
b0bottle.description: A bottle that survives being dropped down the stairwell at least twice.

b0cable.title: Lumen 2m USB-C 240W Cable
b0cable.description: The cable the monitor should have come with if you sit further than a metre away.
